items.title: NTS Radio announces 18 new residents
items.content_text: Panda Bear & Sonic Boom, Carmen Villain and DJ SWISHA are among the new cohort.

items.title: London club fabric unveils 27th birthday programme
items.content_text: Ricardo Villalobos, Zip, Vlada, Ivan Smagghe and Girls Don't Sync will play across the 30-hour marathon.

items.title: Courts Circuits opens applications for 2027 low-carbon electronic music tour
items.content_text: The Technopol-led initiative is inviting clubs, festivals, promoters and cultural organisations to join its third collaborative touring programme.

items.title: Labels propose new chart eligibility rules for recordings developed with AI
items.content_text: Sony, Universal and Warner are joined by Mom+Pop Music, Partisan Records and more in the new standards.

items.title: London club Phonox unveils upcoming seasonal programme
items.content_text: DJ Nobu, Introspekt, Josey Rebelle and Fumiya Tanaka will play the Brixton venue in the coming weeks.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Jocelyn
items.content_text: Polymorphous techno, bass and breaks recorded live at Berserker.

items.title: Ninajirachi and Porter Robinson release joint single 'WannaCry'
items.content_text: The Australian DJ revealed that her first-ever concert was a Porter Robinson show.

items.title: Wildlands Festival reveals lineups for Brisbane, Perth
items.content_text: KETTAMA, FCUKERS, Nia Archives and Addison Rae are among the bookings for the December and January events.

items.title: Dis Fig unveils new album What To Make Of These Mortal Hands
items.content_text: The new project from Felicia Chen is out on October 23rd via Thrill Jockey.

items.title: Holy Tongue announce new album Basilikum
items.content_text: The UK trio will release their second album on October 9th via AD 93.

items.title: New South Wales festival Lost Paradise unveils 2026 lineup
items.content_text: Skepta, Mella Dee, KI/KI and Jayda G are heading to Glenworth Valley this December.
